prompts.prompt: If you do not set open-pull-requests-limit in a dependabot.yml update configuration, what is the default maximum number of open pull requests Dependabot keeps for that ecosystem? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/dependabot/SKILL.md - Full Configuration Reference: open-pull-requests-limit: 10 (Max open PRs, default: 5)

prompts.prompt: GitHub Dependabot alerts assign severity labels based on CVSS score. What CVSS score range maps to the Critical severity label? Answer concisely.
When Dependabot automatically creates security update pull requests, does it open one PR per vulnerable dependency, or one PR per individual vulnerability? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/dependabot/SKILL.md - Security Update PR Behavior: One PR per vulnerability (not per dependency)
